item.title: Warm Through Saturday, Cold Blast Coming Late Sunday!
item.description: WBBJ 7 Forecast Update: The temperature and humidity was on the rise today and both will continue to stay high through Saturday. We could be close to record highs in the mid 70s for the days around Christmas for all of West Tennessee. Overnight lows are forecast to linger in the low 60s. The winds will be breezy at times...
